summary: GeoVax Labs filed an 8-K reporting a warrant exercise inducement offer. A holder exercised existing warrants for 5,697,628 shares, yielding ~$3.646M gross proceeds, and received new warrants for up to 11,395,256 shares at $0.64 per share, exercisable after stockholder approval. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as exclusive financial advisor with a 7% cash fee. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with unregistered sales of equity securities, not a special situation like a tender offer or restructuring. The filing is a standard material agreement and equity sale report, with no change of control or strategic event. Watch for potential dilution and Nasdaq approval of the new warrant exercise.
